operatorProperties.code:
def process(helicopterRequestsByRegion) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = helicopterRequestsByRegion.copy()

    # Keep only the 10 NICC-defined geographic areas (exclude rollups/non-areas)
    exclude = {
        'National Interagency Coordination Center',
        'Other',
        'Canada',
    }
    df = df[~df['Region'].isin(exclude)]

    # If any area appears multiple times, aggregate defensively
    out = (
        df.groupby('Region', as_index=False)['Total Helicopter Requests']
        .sum()
        .sort_values('Total Helicopter Requests', ascending=False)
        .head(1)
    )
    return out
